title: The raw-read hint never fires under the PowerShell tool on Windows
goal: The PreToolUse raw-read hint in .claude/settings.json matches Bash|PowerShell, and kb_hook.is_raw_read also recognises Get-Content, gc, cat, type and Select-String on a kb article, so a Windows session without Git Bash gets the same hint

run: import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json',encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; sys.exit(0 if any('PowerShell' in e.get('matcher','') and any('kb_hook.py' in x.get('command','') for x in e['hooks']) for e in h) else 1)
